System maintains full lifecycle history with timestamps and user identifiers for all status changes and lifecycle events

exceptions: Authorized users can manually activate rent records in Approved status before rental start date
Authorized users can manually complete rent records in Active status before rental end date
Authorized users can cancel rent records in Approved or Active status (in addition to Requested status)
